request.recipient: Intersect treasury reserve smart contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Integration Standard, Year 2, including part-time maintenance over 12 months and Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve and a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee, totaling 540,750 ADA.
UTxO RPC is described as an open interface specification for UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The maintainer scope covers protobuf specification maintenance, SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal says UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface or ecosystem standard.
The project is said to maintain more than 10 repositories and remain fully open-source under Apache 2.0.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and provides references to voting results and audit materials.
The requested withdrawal is asserted not to breach the 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, with a governance-action reference provided.
Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are said to be included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
The proposal identifies Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl as the six external Oversight Committee entities for specified smart-contract administrative checks.

TxPipe is said to have delivered 26 of 30 prior Project Catalyst proposals, with 4 under development on schedule, and to be delivering prior Intersect-funded Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC maintenance on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA through Intersect for a 12-month UTxO RPC maintenance program by TxPipe, with described technical maintenance work, Intersect budget-process references, smart-contract custody arrangements, and oversight controls.
